Bernie showed up with a wrapped gift, handed it to me, and said it was cologne—like it was some kind of farewell present—then told me Claire forced him to end our friendship.
After Bernie left, I sat there staring at my drink, and then I saw this guy—Jacob—watching me with this look like I was a complete mess, like I was something broken he could fix.
I told Tracy to make sure my azaleas got enough sun—anything to avoid saying what I really felt—then got in the truck, and backed straight into the fence.

Jacob didn't just mock how I talk — he told me my wife cheated because I failed her as a husband, as a man, and something in me just... broke.

I found an envelope in Jessica's drawer with my name on it, and when I opened it, whatever was inside nearly made me collapse.
